senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. גנן) [to cover, surround,] to caress, grace, favor.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:5">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> (in children’s acrostics) <he>זֹן אותך וחָ֗ן אותך</he> sustains and graces thee.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:6">Num. R. s. 11</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 6:25">Num. VI, 25</cite>) <he>יָחוֹן איתך בבנים</he> may He favor thee with (good) children.
<cite ref="Numbers 6:25">Ib.</cite> (quot. from daily prayers) <he>אתה חוֹנֵן לאדם דעת</he> thou graciously endowest man with knowledge.
<cite ref="Numbers 6:25">Ib.</cite> <he>עתיד הקב״ה לָחוֹן עליהם</he> the Lord will in due time protect them.

Sifré Num. 41 יָחְנְךָ בתלמוד תורה may He grace thee by enabling thee to study the Law. Pesik. Asser, p. 97ᵃ (ref. to מהונך, Prov. III, 9) ממה שחֲנָנְךָ out of what He has endowed thee with; a. fr.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII חָן, v. חָנָה.]—Part. pass. חָניּן, pl. חֲנוּנִים

senses.gloss: graced, endowed. Num. R. l. c. חֲנוּנֵי (ב)דעת endowed with knowledge.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 87a:13">Pes. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>בני חֲנוּנֶיךָ</he> children of thy favored ones, Abraham &c. (Ms., v. <cite ref="B00481"><he>בָּחַן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 5:4">Sabb. V, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01264"><he>חָנוּן</he> I</cite>, 2.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 26:10">Is. XXVI, 10</cite>) <he>אבל אם למד … אינו נ׳</he> but if he has learned …, he will be shown no favor (will not be forgiven).

senses.gloss: to bend one’s self, to supplicate (v. תְּחִנָּה).
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>, beg. <cite ref="H01311"><he>מִתְחַנֵּן</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="H00040"><he>חָבַט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:5">Ib.</cite> <he>התחיל להִתְחַנֵּן</he> (<he>התחיל מתחנן</he>) he began to pray; a. fr.

senses.gloss: = חָנָה) to come to rest, to be collected.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 30b">Ber. 30ᵇ</cite> (adopting the expression in conformity with <he>ואתחנן</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 3:23">Deut. III, 23</cite>) until his mind be collected again (for prayer), v. <cite ref="H00319"><he>חוּל</he></cite>.
